# Map label glyphs

Unmodified Noto Sans Regular and Bold PBF glyphs, SIL Open Font License 1.1
(see LICENSE.md), from maplibre/demotiles revision
`601ae60796ceceda2cbd2ed3d2ea92d17a84be4b`, `font/`.
Upstream generation: https://github.com/openmaptiles/fonts.

The 0–255 range covers the retained civic boundary labels. These files are
served with the application so its production Content Security Policy does not
require an external demo font host. When adding labels outside this range,
vendor the corresponding 256-codepoint range for both weights and verify it
through the real browser renderer.
